{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm 'status' column has 'completed'
assert 'completed' in df['status'].unique(), "'completed' not found in status column"

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if revenue is numeric
print("Revenue dtype:", df_completed['revenue'].dtype)

# Try to convert revenue to float, coercing errors to NaN
df_completed['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df_completed['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for NaN values
print("Number of NaN revenue values:", df_completed['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue'].sum()

total_revenue"}
